release_notes:
BatchFox 1.0.3.12 (beta): what's new since 1.0.3.11
- In Crop, viewing a photo in the filmstrip no longer marks it for saving. Only photos you actually compose are saved or exported.
- Upscale now shows live progress as it runs: the photo it is on, how many are done, the time left, and a Stop button. Even a single large photo keeps moving instead of looking frozen, and the bottom bar follows along.
- Coming-soon tabs no longer cut off their text.
